sentences.text:
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.10111 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.799 of 2025 on the file of the Medipally Police Station, Hyderabad against the petitioners- accused Nos.1 and 2.
2.
The petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.799 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard Mr.P.Sravan Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that though the petitioners have to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment of less than seven years, the Police concerned have not issued any notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023, as such,
the petitioners are apprehending coercive measures against them.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioners are ready to cooperate with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue 35 (3)
of BNSS, 2023 notice and as per his instructions, the petitioners are not available for personal service and they may directed to cooperate with the investigation.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment below seven years and as the petitioners are to engage themselves in the process, without going into merits of the matter, the petitioners are directed to appear before the SHO, Medipally Police Station,
Hyderabad, within a period of one (1) week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order,
whereupon, the Investigating Officer shall issue notice on the petitioner under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 in Crime No.799 of 2025 and take up further proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.
